sentences.text: The petitioner Raju Saikia has filed this application u/s 438 Cr.Pc with prayer of pre- arrest bail as he apprehending arrest in connection with Special POCSO Case No. 158/2022 arising out of Nagaon P.S. Case No. 2972/2019 registered under Section 376 IPC read with Section 4 of POCSO Act.
3. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he is a Constable and in case he is forwarded to custody he will be terminated from service.
He will suffer immensely in the event he is terminated from the service as he is 57 years old and he is the sole bread winner of the family.

4. I have considered the submissions at the Bar with circumspection and I have perused the scanned copy of the LCR.
5.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the victim has alleged that the petitioner has committed sexual assault on her but the petitioner has proved that he is on duty at the time of the incident i.e. on 08.10.2019.
The Annexure-5 series are the attendance signatures which clearly depicts that the petitioner was on duty at the time of the incident.
The main accused is allegedly the petitioner's younger brother.
It is submitted that it is not plausible that the two brothers will commit the offence of sexual assault on the same victim.
The petitioner has pledged to cooperate with the trial.
6. A careful scrutiny of the scanned copies of the LCR reveals that the Medico Legal Report has not been forwarded with the LCR.

7. Considering the submissions at the Bar, the petitioner is directed to appear before the trial Court within 15 days and apply for bail, which may be considered by the learned trial Court as per merits of the case.
Till then no coercive action may be taken.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
